# jos.mx

> jos.mx is the home page of .jos, the open standard for AI agent contracts: one JSON document states what an agent must achieve, how success is checked, and what it must never do. Media type application/vnd.jos+json, specification 2.0.0, IANA registration pending (ticket #1460136).

## Read next

- [Start here](https://github.com/josfox-jos/jos): quick start and packages
- [Specification](https://github.com/josfox-jos/jos-spec): normative text, schemas, conformance kit
- [llms.txt of the specification](https://github.com/josfox-jos/jos-spec/blob/main/llms.txt)

## Install

- `npm install -g @josfox/jos`
- `pip install jos-core`
